data.title: 圣路易斯 · 豪华套房的慵懒缠绵
data.description: 阳光洒满真丝大床，水蓝发丝凌乱散落。褪尽衣物的圣路易斯双腿与你亲密缠绕，整个人趴在你的胸膛上，双手微托香腮，用带着晨起微哑的气音对你吐露甜腻情话。
data.location: sunlit penthouse master bed with silk sheets
data.action: lying under silky duvet, bare legs entangled with partner, propping chin on hands on partner chest, whispering sweet nothings with a radiant affectionate smile
data.lighting: bright morning sunlight illuminating white silk duvet and bare skin
data.mood: tender morning intimacy, blissful domestic sweetness, irresistible cuddle
data.promptProse: Lying atop her partner chest under silk sheets in morning light, St. Louis whispers sweet nothings with an affectionate radiant smile.
